_readme.about: Tradetron strategy export. Edit and re-import via the ASB Import button.
_readme.logic: To change a condition's logic, edit its "conditionJson" (the AST). The "conditionValue"/"conditionDisplay" text is regenerated from it on import.
_readme.legs: For a leg field that has a "*Json" (e.g. "strikeJson"), edit the JSON — its text form is regenerated on import. Fields with no "*Json" (e.g. "qty") are plain text: edit them directly.
_readme.structure: Add/remove/duplicate legs, conditions or sets by editing the arrays.
_readme.do_not: Do not add "*_id" foreign keys back. Lists referenced by id must be ones you own.

name: Sensex 3Min OTM4 Test Momentum Strategy
description:
Sensex 3Min OTM4 Test Momentum Strategy (Relaxed Testing Rules)

Strategy Notes & Trading Intent:

--------------------------------------------------

1. Entry Criteria:

  • Underlying: SENSEX Index (BSE) (3m Candles (Current Week Expiry)).
  • Entry Window: Between 9:20 AM and 3:00 PM IST.
  • Trigger Condition: Enters Long CE on BSE when 3-min Close[-1] > Close[-2] + Spot_Confirm (3.0 pt). Enters Long PE when Close[-1] < Close[-2] - Spot_Confirm (3.0 pt). Single bar trigger designed for immediate verification of trade execution.

2. Exit Criteria & Risk Parameters:

  • Target & Stop Loss: Target 2.0x (+100%), Stop Loss 0.8x (-20%), Universal Exit 3:15 PM IST.
  • Universal Exit: Square off all intraday open positions at 3:15 PM IST.

3. Additional Mechanics:

  • Relaxed threshold (3.0 pt single bar on BSE) ensures rapid condition evaluation in live testing.
